label: Dramatic Light
description: High-contrast, moody, stylized light — the theatrical end of the spectrum, every item naming direction, edge quality and what motivates the source.

items.name: chiaroscuro
items.text: chiaroscuro from a single hard source set high and to one side, lit planes emerging bright out of absolute black with no fill anywhere, the transition from highlight to darkness snapping within a finger's width

items.name: neon-rim
items.text: electric neon rim light, magenta tracing one edge of the silhouette and cyan the other, two colored contour lines burning against darkness while the front of the subject holds barely a stop above black

items.name: single-practical
items.text: one bare practical bulb overhead, a harsh pool of light directly below it, hard-edged noir shadows dropping vertically down every face

items.name: volumetric-shafts
items.text: hard volumetric shafts cutting through drifting haze from high behind the scene, parallel god-ray beams made solid by the atmosphere, dust igniting to bright points as it crosses each blade of light

items.name: silhouette-backlight
items.text: one powerful backlight aimed nearly into the lens from behind the subject, the figure reduced to a clean black cutout inside a burning halo, flare wrapping the contour where hair and edges eat into the light

items.name: police-strobe
items.text: alternating red and blue emergency strobes raking the scene from off-frame, hard-edged shadows swapping direction with every flash, wet surfaces throwing the two colors back in turn

items.name: lightning-flash
items.text: a lightning strike frozen at peak, one instant of blinding blue-white top-light etching every edge against the charcoal storm, doubled shadows where the bolt overwhelms the ambient

items.name: underlight
items.text: hard light thrown upward from below the chin, every familiar shadow inverted — eye sockets lit, brows shading upward — the campfire-horror geometry that makes any face read wrong

items.name: stage-spot
items.text: a tight followspot from high front in a hazed theater, its cone visible in the air, one hard circle of light on the boards and everything outside the pool dropping to pure black

items.name: split-lighting
items.text: hard split lighting from exactly ninety degrees, the terminator running down the centerline of the face, one eye in full light and the other in shadow with only a catchlight surviving

items.name: ground-mist
items.text: ethereal mist clinging to the ground, soft diffused glow and low volumetric beams drifting knee-high, quietly mysterious

items.name: window-gobo
items.text: hard light through an unseen window frame, the tall shadow grid of panes and muntins projected across wall and subject, noir geometry sliding with the light angle

items.name: searchlight-beams
items.text: searchlight beams sweeping up from below the horizon line, hard columns of light crossing overhead and silvering the underside of the cloud deck

items.name: eye-slash
items.text: a noir slit of hard light laid precisely across the eyes while the rest of the face falls dark, one bright band making the gaze the only readable feature
